_howto: Add one entry per event. date is YYYY-MM-DD. For a multi-day event add endDate (YYYY-MM-DD); it stays listed until the end date passes. time, location and description are optional. Past events disappear automatically. Keep the commas between entries and no comma after the last one.

events.title: Veterans Day
events.location: Calvert County Courthouse, 175 Main Street Prince Frederick, MD 20678
events.description: Join us in honoring the brave men and women who have served our country at Calvert County’s annual Veterans Day Ceremony. The event will take place on the Courthouse Greens in Prince Frederick. In the event of rain, the ceremony will be moved indoors to the Calvert County Circuit Courthouse. All are welcome to attend as we pay tribute to our veterans and their service to our nation.
